name: Misham
title: Benjamite from the lineage of David
summary: Misham was a Benjamite mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Shaharaim. He belonged to the tribe of Benjamin and is part of the genealogical lists documenting Israel's tribal history in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Misham is listed as a son of Shaharaim and Hodesh in the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Benjamin in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Misham is included in the extensive genealogical record compiled to document Israel's tribal structure after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Family Relations in Moab
keyEvents.description: Misham's father, Shaharaim, had children in the land of Moab after sending away his former wives Hushim and Baara. Misham was born to his wife Hodesh.

keyEvents.title: Benjamite Family Head
keyEvents.description: Misham and his brothers are described as heads of their families, indicating a leadership role within the tribe of Benjamin.
